title: 红丝带回来了  (The Red Ribbon)

segments.t: Tuesday morning dawns bright and clear at Courtyard Inn in Chengdu. Teacher Song hurries down to the front desk, where Qing and Chen have her returned suitcase waiting. Listen to the whole scene first.
宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
里面的茶杯呢？还完好吗？
一点没破！是谁送回来的？
我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
'Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.' Compact time compound:
昨晚
squeezes 'yesterday evening' into two crisp syllables.
里面的茶杯呢？还完好吗？
'And the teacup inside? Is it still intact?' Slipping
呢
after a noun phrase turns 'the teacup inside' into a quick follow-up question: 'And what about the teacup?'.
一点没破！是谁送回来的？
'Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?' Framing 'who brought it back' inside the 'is... one' wrapper spotlights the unknown person rather than the delivery itself.
真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
'How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.' Literally 'eye-familiar',
眼熟
describes a face or handwriting you recognize by sight even before placing the name.
真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
'Really? Do you know someone here in Chengdu?' Location phrases sit before the action in Mandarin, so 'in Chengdu know someone' puts the city ahead of 'know'.
二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
'Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.' Putting
前
after a span of time means 'ago': 'twenty-five years before' for 'twenty-five years ago'.
现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
'For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.' Adding
着
right after 'lock' keeps the state ongoing—the suitcase stays locked rather than just getting locked once.
太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
'Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.' Meals have their own counting word,
顿
used whenever you talk about one proper breakfast, lunch, or dinner. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
里面的茶杯呢？还完好吗？
一点没破！是谁送回来的？
我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
Teacher Song has her teacup and clothes back, and a twenty-five-year-old memory is starting to stir. Next, trouble brews in the breakfast kitchen. See you next time.
回头见！
